artifact_type: metadata correction; original run artifacts preserved
evidence: Settings verified against the executed trainer stored in source_snapshot.json and the recorded CLI arguments in config.json.
note: The original config merged parent Adam metadata into this L-BFGS run. Overlay effective_config for reporting this run. Historical config, manifest, source snapshot and history have not been rewritten. No objective, gradients, checkpoint selection or live training behavior was changed.

effective_config.optimizer: L-BFGS-B on network weights, fixed objective; unbounded neural weights
effective_config.precision: float32 MLX values/gradients, float64 SciPy optimizer vectors
effective_config.selection: original four development recovery surfaces; never exposed-12 truth in optimizer

steps.reason: Parent Adam step count. This run uses an L-BFGS maxiter budget of 1000.

lr.reason: Parent Adam learning rate. L-BFGS uses its line search; no Adam learning rate is applied.

weight_decay.reason: Parent AdamW decay. The L-BFGS objective contains no neural-weight decay term.

resample_every.reason: Parent Adam collocation refresh. This solve uses fixed anchor and physics samples throughout.

batch.reason: Parent stochastic anchor batch. Every L-BFGS objective evaluates all 16384 fixed anchors, accumulated in chunks.

pde_batch.reason: Parent stochastic PDE batch. Every L-BFGS objective evaluates all 18000 fixed collocation points, accumulated in chunks.
